title: Multiple Myeloma
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for multiple myeloma. Captures treatment phase (newly diagnosed, maintenance, relapsed/refractory) as a scenario tag, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Multiple Myeloma; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Multiple Myeloma. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Treatment phase
nodes.title: Treatment phase
nodes.description: Multiple myeloma management differs by treatment phase - newly diagnosed disease requiring induction therapy, post-induction maintenance therapy, or relapsed/refractory disease after prior treatment.

nodes.name: Newly diagnosed: triplet / quadruplet induction
nodes.title: Newly diagnosed: triplet / quadruplet induction
nodes.description: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma - triplet or quadruplet induction combining a proteasome inhibitor, immunomodulatory agent, and/or anti-CD38 antibody with dexamethasone is standard first-line therapy, with eligibility for autologous stem cell transplant guiding regimen choice. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Maintenance: lenalidomide
nodes.title: Maintenance: lenalidomide
nodes.description: Post-induction (including post-transplant) maintenance therapy - lenalidomide maintenance is standard to prolong disease control. Physician selects.

nodes.name: Relapsed/refractory: pomalidomide-dexamethasone
nodes.title: Relapsed/refractory: pomalidomide-dexamethasone
nodes.description: Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma - pomalidomide with dexamethasone is an option for disease progressing after prior immunomodulatory- and proteasome inhibitor-based therapy. Physician selects.
